import requests
r = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:3900/generate", data={
    "text": TEXT,
    "language": "English",
    "profile_id": "MABEL_ID",
    "duration": 5.0,
    "seed": 740,
})
open("take.wav", "wb").write(r.content)

client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:3900/v1", api_key="local")
client.audio.speech.create(model="omnivoice", voice="MABEL_ID",
    input=TEXT, speed=1.25).write_to_file("take.mp3")
